sections.title: -ban/-ben for most workplaces
sections.content: To say where you work, use dolgozik with the workplace in -ban/-ben, the same locative case you already use for iskolában or a boltban. Most workplace nouns follow this pattern: egy irodában ("in an office"), egy boltban ("in a shop"), egy kórházban ("in a hospital"), egy gyárban ("in a factory"). A few nouns are exceptions and take -on/-en/-ön instead — egyetemen ("at university") is the one you'll meet most often.

items.english: Where do you work? – I work in an office.

items.spanish: Zsófia egy kórházban dolgozik, mert orvos.
items.english: Zsófia works in a hospital, because she's a doctor.

items.spanish: Anna egy boltban dolgozik, mert eladó.
items.english: Anna works in a shop, because she's a salesperson.

sections.content: dolgozik is an -ik verb, so remember dolgozom (I work), not dolgozok — the same -ik pattern you already know from alszik and reggelizik.
